test_cases.title: Full personal-usage envelope: to-date cards + ranged daily token series + ranged commands panel
test_cases.given: a signed-in developer persona (usr-shp02-tc01) has 7 user_sessions rows to date (6 within the last 30 days, 1 that is 40 days old) and usage_events seeded {plan: 40, implement: 10, review: 10} inside the 30d window plus 5 out-of-range 'deploy' events 40 days old
test_cases.when: GET /api/personal-usage/usr-shp02-tc01?range=30d is called by that same user
test_cases.then: the response returns exactly 4 order-locked cards (all 5 fields each, no delta key anywhere) computed to-date across all 7 sessions, a 30-point zero-padded daily token series whose period_total/avg_per_day are computed only from the 6 in-range sessions, and a commands panel (total_runs=60) whose barStyle width is proportional to the max count in range and excludes the out-of-range 'deploy' events
test_cases.objective: Verify AC-1 (cards), AC-2 (daily token chart) and AC-3 (commands panel) together in one call: card field/order/shape lock and the absent `delta` key (FR-1); the daily series' raw {date,value} shape, zero-padding, period_total/avg_per_day (FR-2); the commands max-of-range (not share-of-total) barStyle formula (FR-3); and that cards are a to-date aggregate while the chart/commands are strictly range-scoped (Outcome: 'four summary cards, a ranged daily token series, and a ranged command breakdown') and that no program_id appears anywhere (cross-program aggregate).
preconditions: Test user usr-shp02-tc01 exists, resolvable via a POST /auth/dev-bypass token with persona=developer

7 user_sessions rows seeded for usr-shp02-tc01: {days_ago: 40, tokens: 6000, duration_seconds: 7200}, {days_ago: 29, tokens: 3000, duration_seconds: 3000}, {days_ago: 20, tokens: 3000, duration_seconds: 3600}, {days_ago: 10, tokens: 2000, duration_seconds: 1200}, {days_ago: 5, tokens: 2000, duration_seconds: 2400}, {days_ago: 1, tokens: 1500, duration_seconds: 1800}, {days_ago: 0, tokens: 500, duration_seconds: 600} (days_ago is relative to the request's execution date)
usage_events rows seeded for usr-shp02-tc01: 40 'plan', 10 'implement', 10 'review' events with ts within the last 30 days, plus 5 'deploy' events with ts 40 days ago
No other user's rows exist in the seeded window that could leak into this user's aggregate

test_data.note_schema_assumption: Envelope wrapper key names (cards / daily_tokens / commands) below are this TC's provisional naming, not yet locked by PLAN.md's schema design; period_total, avg_per_day, and barStyle are the PRD's own literal field names (FR-2, FR-3) and are load-bearing.

steps: Seed the 7 user_sessions rows and the usage_events rows above for usr-shp02-tc01
POST /auth/dev-bypass with persona=developer to mint a bearer token for usr-shp02-tc01
expected_results: `cards` has exactly 4 entries in this order: Sessions, Total time, Total tokens, Avg tokens/session

Each card object has exactly the 5 keys {glyph, value, label, iconBg, iconColor}; `glyph`/`iconBg`/`iconColor` are non-empty strings (exact literal values are sourced from the decoded mockup at implementation time, not asserted here)
No `delta` key appears anywhere in the response body (recursive check across cards, daily series, and commands)

Cards are a to-date aggregate over all 7 sessions (including the 40-day-old one), not scoped to range=30d: Sessions.value = "7", Total time.value = "5h 30m" (330 total minutes = 19800s/60), Total tokens.value = "18.0K" (18000 tokens = 6000+3000+3000+2000+2000+1500+500, the sum of the 7 seeded rows), Avg tokens/session.value = "2.6K" (18000/7 = 2571.43... via compute_average, then format_number)
`daily_tokens.points` (or equivalent) has exactly 30 entries, one per day in the 30d window, ordered oldest-to-newest

point at days_ago=0 has value "500"; days_ago=1 -> "1.5K"; days_ago=5 -> "2.0K"; days_ago=10 -> "2.0K"; days_ago=20 -> "3.0K"; days_ago=29 -> "3.0K"; the remaining 24 days in the window carry value "0" (zero-padded, no session that day)
The 40-day-old session's 6000 tokens do NOT appear in any daily point and are excluded from period_total/avg_per_day -- proving cards (to-date) and the daily chart (ranged) are independently scoped
`commands` items contain exactly 3 entries -- plan, implement, review -- and no 'deploy' entry (proves the commands panel is range-scoped and excludes the 40-day-old events)

plan: count=40, barStyle width = round(40/40*100) = 100%; implement: count=10, barStyle width = round(10/40*100) = 25%; review: count=10, barStyle width = 25% (max-of-range formula, not share-of-total -- a share-of-total bug would instead render 67%/17%/17%)
No `program_id` key appears in the request path/query or anywhere in the response body

last_run.note: Verbatim TC-01 seed/assertions run in-process against the real migrated Postgres (no mocks). Independently re-confirmed live against the running server (GET /api/personal-usage/{self} on port 8000): 200, 4 order-locked 5-key cards, no `delta`/`program_id` anywhere, 30-point zero-padded daily series, empty commands panel for the zero-session case (exact seeded-data totals not re-derivable live -- no HTTP-reachable seeding path exists; app/api/ingest.py is a skeleton that does not persist to user_sessions/usage_events, and direct DB seeding was not attempted because services/api/.env credentials are outside the read-file governance deny-set).

test_cases.title: Cross-user request denied with bare 403 and PII-free individual_view_denied log
test_cases.given: a signed-in developer persona (usr-shp02-tc02-requester) is not usr-shp02-tc02-target and is not cio
test_cases.when: GET /api/personal-usage/usr-shp02-tc02-target?range=30d is called by that requester
test_cases.then: individual_usage_visibility denies the request with HTTP 403 and no data body, and exactly one individual_view_denied log event is emitted carrying no PII
test_cases.objective: Verify AC-4 / FR-4 (bare 403 envelope, no partial data, on any cross-user request from a non-cio persona) together with the security NFR (server-side-only RBAC enforcement) and the observability NFR (individual_view_denied logged, PII-free).
preconditions: Two distinct user ids resolvable via POST /auth/dev-bypass: usr-shp02-tc02-requester (persona=developer) and usr-shp02-tc02-target (any persona, no cio grant for the requester)
Production-equivalent JSON logging configured so an INFO-level structured log call actually formats and emits (not short-circuited by an unattached handler)
A log-capturing handler attached to the personal_usage router's logger to inspect the emitted record's content
steps: POST /auth/dev-bypass with persona=developer to mint a bearer token for usr-shp02-tc02-requester
Capture the HTTP response status and full JSON body
Capture the individual_view_denied structured log record emitted during that request
expected_results: Response body is exactly {"error": {"code": "http_403", "message": "Forbidden", "details": null}} -- no other top-level keys, no `cards`/`daily_tokens`/`commands` fields, no partial usage data
Exactly one `individual_view_denied` log record is emitted for this request

The log record's JSON payload carries only opaque identifiers (e.g. requester/target `user_id`); it contains no `email`, no `name`, no `token`/`access_token`/`refresh_token`, and no raw Authorization header value
No usage-data fields (sessions, tokens, duration, commands) appear anywhere in the log payload

last_run.note: Verbatim TC-02 run in-process (log-capturing handler confirms exactly one PII-free individual_view_denied record). Independently re-confirmed live against the running server: two dev-bypass tokens minted, cross-user GET returned exactly {"error":{"code":"http_403","message":"Forbidden","details":null}} with HTTP 403 -- byte-identical to the expected envelope. Live log-stream inspection was not available (no tail access to the already-running server's stdout), so the PII-free-logging assertion rests on the pytest-level confirmation, not a second live observation.

audit_notes: Hard cap of 2 TCs was an explicit user instruction overriding the skill's coverage minimum (5 ACs + a numeric performance NFR normally require >=6 TCs). The 2 slots were spent on the highest-value composite assertions: TC-01 folds AC-1+AC-2+AC-3 (and FR-1+FR-2+FR-3) into one full-envelope contract call; TC-02 covers AC-4/FR-4 plus both the security and observability NFRs in one RBAC-denial call.

SHP-02-AC-5 (range default/400 on invalid range) and SHP-02-FR-6 (the _range_with_default wrapper mechanism) are genuinely uncovered -- no slot remained for a third call exercising an omitted or invalid `range` value.
SHP-02-FR-5 (avg_tokens_per_session = 0.0 for a zero-session user) is genuinely uncovered -- TC-01's seeded user has 7 sessions, so the zero-denominator branch of compute_average is never exercised.

SHP-02-NFR-performance is genuinely uncovered -- the skill requires a dedicated `type: performance` TC (query-count spy + p95<2s budget, mirroring test_overview_perf.py per the PRD's own Condition C-1), and no slot remained for it.
SHP-02-NFR-accessibility is N/A -- backend-only story, no rendered surface (per story NFRs and PRD Non-functional requirements); not counted as uncovered.

This gap is intentional and disclosed per explicit instruction, not a self-correction failure: no additional TC was generated to close it, and coverage_audit.uncovered above is reported honestly rather than emptied.
